name: io.github.lookproof/lookproof-mcp
title: Lookproof DNS, mail and TLS security checks
description: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, DNSSEC, TLS and DNS checks. Free API key or pay-per-call (x402).

environmentVariables.name: LOOKPROOF_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Lookproof API key (lp_...). Calls use your plan's credits, no wallet needed. Free key with 250 credits a month: https://lookproof.dev/pricing

environmentVariables.name: X402_PAY
environmentVariables.description: x402 only: set to 1 to pay for calls in USDC. Without it (and without LOOKPROOF_API_KEY) every tool is a dry run that only reports the price.

environmentVariables.name: PRIVATE_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file (chmod 600) with the private key of a dedicated wallet holding a few dollars of USDC on Base

environmentVariables.name: PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated wallet (alternative to PRIVATE_KEY_FILE)

environmentVariables.name: MAX_SPEND_USD
environmentVariables.description: Spending cap per session (one server process) in USD

environmentVariables.name: PAYTO_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated addresses the server may pay; a 402 asking for any other payTo is refused

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: Bearer followed by your Lookproof API key (lp_live_...). Each tool call then uses your plan's credits. Without it the server is a small free trial (a few calls a day, single checks only). No wallet needed.
